newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks weaken in London as Dow slides.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks weaken in London as Dow slides.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks slid to their lows for the day as the Dow opened with steep losses after the U.S. launched a strike on Iraqi targets.

By 1339 GMT, the Hang Seng London Reference Index was sitting on its intraday low at 10,878.46, down 78.72 points, as the Dow fell some 50 points within the first 10 minutes of the U.S. trading session.
In Hong Kong, the Hang Seng Index fell 149.39 points to 10,957.18 as the U.S. air strikes added to worries about interest rates.
Interest-rate sensitive bank stocks led the drop in London, but traders said the downside is likely to be limited as the 10,800 level on the HSLR is perceived as strong chart support.
"This isn't even a case of heavy selling," said one London trader. "It's more a case of market markets avoiding trading.
